>>278727661
Ten years ago the smartphone was normalized and from that day forward no kid ever fell down from a tree, no kid was ever bored, no kid was ever sad to be grounded and no kid ever had an incentive to go outside.
From that day forward no man ever had to talk to another person lest it became awkward.
You did not sit next to strangers in lunchtime because you had a phone and can sit by yourself, you did not meat the woman of your dreams because you were to busy playing candy crush.
The starchild was never born because you did not inseminate the woman of your dreams.
The son was never to become, the most valueable object in your life, what you would sacrifice your life to defend never came to be, because you never knew you had the choice.
You've lost so much you don't know.
Because nobody cares about the treasure they could've had if they knew, but they don't.
Fast forward ten years.
The omnitreadmill is revealed, and you can now play virtual reality in high definition and enjoy your virtual world, with a virtual girl, and a virtual marriage, with no side effects.
It is going to be great, all the dopamine you can eat.
Except of course that nothing carries any weight, nothing is at stake, there is nothing to defend from anything.
And you know this, maybe you could be programmed to not know this and enjoy a fake reality in which you believe the stakes to be real, but you know they aren't NOW.
Without stakes, there is no motivation for any choice.
Motivation is religious in nature, built in to the selfish gene, instinct is manifested in our religion in drives the motivation for everything, meaning, being everything.
God is dead and so are you, i have no god and i must feel.
